title: Luis Enrique lauds PSG's mentality after comeback win
subtitle: Paris Saint-Germain fell behind to Strasbourg, but Luis Enrique was delighted with the mentality demonstrated by his team in a 3-1 win.
paragraphs: Paris Saint-Germain proved their mentality in their 3-1 comeback win over Strasbourg, so says Luis Enrique.
Two-time European champions PSG fell behind to Giovanni Reyna's effort in the 17th minute at Stade de la Meinau.

However, a late turnaround secured a dramatic victory, with Illia Zabarnyi's 77th-minute leveller paving the way for substitutes Ousmane Dembele, who had earlier missed a penalty, and Desire Doue to clinch the three points.

PSG have now won their last six games in all competitions. Only Barcelona, who Luis Enrique's team face in the Champions League on Tuesday, have a longer current winning streak among teams from the top five European leagues.
And Luis Enrique was thrilled with his team's mentality.
"The teams playing against us have extra motivation, and that is what is difficult to manage when you are a player for a team like PSG," he said.
"But I'm happy. We expected to have difficulties, but we started the match positively. We needed that first goal to feel comfortable in the game.
